subject: Television & Streaming
title: George Costanza: The Lovable Loser
description: A 60-second lesson on George Costanza: The Lovable Loser.

hook.text: George Costanza was petty, dishonest, lazy, and cheap. He was also the funniest character on television's funniest show.

buildup.text: Jason Alexander based George on Larry David.

discovery.text: George's genius was that his worst qualities were universally recognizable.

twist.text: In the episode 'The Opposite,' George does the opposite of every instinct and his life improves.

climax.text: George Costanza normalized failure as comedy.

punchline.text: Television's biggest loser became everyone's favorite.

quiz.question: Who was George Costanza based on in real life?
